# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 39 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** God Commands Michael to Guard Adam

---

**1** God commanded Michael: 'Guard Adam's body until the day of the resurrection.'

**2** Michael said: 'Lord, your will be done. I will guard him as you command.'

**3** Michael placed Adam's body in a place of honor and posted angels to guard it.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
